meta.small_group_rule: dept x title groups under 5 people (paid 2025 or currently employed) are rolled into "Other titles (groups under 5 people)" per department. Per-person stats are null when n < 5; p90 is null when n < 10. Department totals are suppressed when under 5 people.

definitions.regular: A0005/A0017/A0000 regular salary, regular time, regular at other rates (MULT n RATE 1_0), REG 1_15, REG 1_125, time entry wages
definitions.retro_lumpsum: appropriation A0003 (retro pay and CBA lump sums)
definitions.other_premium: everything else: duty availability, holiday, comp time and vacation payouts, specialty, uniform allowance, A0032 reimbursable OT, other A0005 elements
definitions.fullyear: persons paid in all 24 pay periods of 2025
definitions.primary_group: each payroll person is assigned to the dept x title with the most non-retro pay in 2025; sums by group include every dollar charged to that group, so sums can include pay of people whose primary group is another title
definitions.annualized_base: annual salary, or hourly rate x typical weekly hours x 52
definitions.n_current: rows of the current-employee roster keyed to a dept and title code
